exposure: Copper T 380A insertion within 48 hours of delivery
cohort: The study included 200 women attending antenatal OPD and emergency clinic in early labour and postnatal wards in India who opted for immediate postpartum IUCD insertion.
finding: The PPIUCD demonstrated a 96% continuation rate at 6 months and was considered a safe method of contraception, with pain being camouflaged by after-pains, leading to higher acceptance.
